textbookText: A. Tick the correct alternative. 1. Name the taxa formed by grouping of order. a. Family b. genus c. Class d. Phylum 2. Which botanical family does Capsicum belongs to? a. solanaceae b. liliaceae c. compositae d. leguminosae 3. What type of placentation is characteristic of the Solanaceae family? a. Axile b. Basal c. Parietal d. marginal 4. The tuber of potato is a modification of which of the following part? a. Root b. Stem c. Fruit d. seed 5. Name the type of fruit formed by whole inflorescence. a. simple fruit b. aggregate fruit c. Composite fruit d. None of above 6. Observe the given diagram and select the correct option.

a. a- basifixed, b- adnate, c- versatile, d- dorsifixed b. a- basifixed, b- versatile, c-adnate, d- dorsifixed c. a- basifixed, b- adnate, c- dorsifixed, d- versatile d. a- basifixed, b- dorsifixed, c- adnate, d- versatile 7. What is the scientific name of cabbage? a. Brassica campestris b. Brassica oleracea c. Raphanus sativus d. Brassica rapa

8. What is meant by a ‘cruciform corolla’ in botanical terms? a. A corolla with petals arranged in a circular pattern b. A corolla with petals arranged in a star like shape c. A corolla with petals arranged in the shape of a cross d. A corolla with petals arranged in a spiral pattern

B. Answer the following questions: 1. Define the following: a. phyllotaxy b. zygomorphic c. complete flower d. genus e. taxonomy f. perianth 2. Differentiate between: a. Tap root system and fibrous root system b. Simple leaf and compound leaf c. Cymose and Racemose d. artificial and natural system of classification 3. Describe the family solanaceae in semi-technical terms with floral formula and floral diagram with two scientific names of economically important plants of this family. 4. Describe the family Liliaceae in semi-technical terms with floral formula and floral diagram with two scientific names of economically important plants of this family. 5. Describe the floral characters of Fabaceae. 6. What is placentation? Describe the different types of placentation. 7. Explain the different region of root with diagram. 8. Describe the morphology of leaf with diagram. 9. Define the term inflorescence. Explain the different types of inflorescence. 10. A group of botanists is conducting a study to classify the plant species found in particular region. They are debating whether to use an artificial system, a natural system, or a phylogenetic system for their classification. Which system would be most suitable for their study, and why?
